stt.deepgram_quality_notice: Alguns idiomas não podem ser usados ​​com a opção de qualidade "aprimorada"
stt.moonshine_desc: Executa sensores úteis Moonshine no Docker ou outro processo. O endpoint deve expor POST/transcribe e GET/health.
stt.moonshine_language_desc: por exemplo pt – deve corresponder ao que o seu servidor Moonshine espera.
stt.openai_audio_desc: Para um servidor em sua máquina (por exemplo, speaches, LocalAI) que implementa POST /v1/audio/transcriptions. O áudio permanece local, a menos que você aponte o URL para um host na nuvem.
stt.openai_audio_api_key: Chave de API (opcional, servidores locais geralmente ignoram)
stt.openai_audio_language_desc: Código ISO se o servidor suportar; deixe em branco para deixar o servidor decidir.
stt.whisper_use_local: Use local .bin file instead of download
stt.whisper_local_path: Path to GGML .bin on this PC
stt.whisper_local_hint: Import saves the file under app data so the next start skips the network. Or enable this option and set a path to copy from each time you start.
stt.vosk_local_path: Path to Vosk model .zip on this PC
stt.vosk_local_hint: Import saves the zip under app data for the selected catalog model. Or enable this option and set a path to copy from each time you start.
stt.rust_input_device_hint: Uses the desktop audio system's microphone names (cpal). Leave on System default to use Settings → Audio settings → Default input device.
stt.native_desktop_hint: Web Speech does not work in the desktop app. Use Whisper, Groq, Vosk, or the Chrome / Edge microphone page instead.
stt.status_whisper_dropped: Whisper is slower than real time and skipped {{seconds}} s of speech. Choose a smaller model or more CPU threads.
stt.status_rate_limited: Rate limit: next request in {{seconds}} s ({{count}} waiting, merged when sent)
stt.status_utterance_dropped: Some speech was skipped because transcription fell behind.
stt.error_requests_failed: {{engine}} stopped after {{attempts}} failed requests. Last error: {{detail}}
stt.error_rate_limit_wait: {{engine}} stopped: the rate limit asks to wait about {{minutes}} min (daily limit reached?). Try again later or switch provider.
stt.error_backlog: {{engine}} fell {{seconds}} s behind and was stopped. Try a faster server or model.
stt.error_groq_key_missing: Groq: enter your API key (free at console.groq.com/keys).
stt.error_http_base_url: Enter the base URL of your transcription server, for example http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1.
stt.error_http_base_url_invalid: "{{url}}" is not a valid URL. Use one such as http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1.
stt.error_http_model: Enter the model id your transcription server expects.
stt.error_moonshine_not_found: No Moonshine server answered at {{endpoint}}. Start it (for example with Docker, port 8090) and try again.
stt.error_deepgram_options: Deepgram: enter your API key and choose a language.
stt.error_azure_options: Azure: enter the key, the region and a language.
stt.error_native_options: Choose a language for Web Speech.
stt.error_native_unavailable: Web Speech is not available here. Use Whisper or Vosk in the desktop app.
stt.error_native_desktop: Web Speech does not work in the desktop app. Use Whisper, Groq, Vosk, or the Chrome / Edge microphone page instead.
stt.migrated_to_whisper: Speech-to-text now uses Whisper on this PC (Web Speech does not work in the desktop app). Press Start once to download the {{model}} model{{size}}.
stt.azure_segmentation_silence_desc: Silence that ends a phrase. Lower gives faster final captions; too low splits sentences. 100-5000, default 500.
stt.vad_desc: Silero VAD decides when you speak. Only speech is transcribed; silence and background noise never are.
stt.vad_threshold_desc: How sure the detector must be that you are speaking. Lower catches quiet speech, higher ignores more noise. Default 0.5.
stt.vad_min_silence_desc: A pause this long closes the sentence and sends it. Shorter feels faster but can split sentences. Default 500.
stt.vad_max_utterance_desc: Longer speech is split at the quietest moment. Default 18000.
stt.whisper_desc: Runs locally with whisper.cpp. The first start downloads the selected model once; your voice never leaves this PC.
stt.whisper_model_desc: Bigger models are more accurate but slower on the CPU. Q5 / Q8 builds are smaller and faster with almost the same accuracy. English-only models are a little better for English.
stt.whisper_anime_hint: Anime-Whisper is a Japanese model for expressive speech. It is not downloaded: convert litagin/anime-whisper to a ggml .bin with whisper.cpp, then use it as a local model file below.
stt.whisper_language_desc: Setting your language is faster and more accurate than detection. English-only models always transcribe English.
stt.whisper_hallucination_filter_desc: Drops phantom phrases such as "Thanks for watching" when they make up a whole sentence, and collapses repeated loops.
stt.whisper_no_speech_threshold_desc: Drops a sentence when Whisper thinks it is not speech with more than this confidence. 1 turns it off. Default 0.6.
stt.whisper_hotwords_desc: Comma-separated names and terms Whisper should spell correctly.
stt.whisper_initial_prompt_desc: Optional text that sets the style and topic, for example "Casual chat in VRChat."
stt.whisper_threads_desc: Automatic uses about half your cores (at most 4) so games keep their CPU time.
stt.whisper_max_backlog_desc: Sentences that may wait for the model. If Whisper falls further behind, the oldest waiting sentence is skipped so captions stay current. Default 3.
stt.groq_desc: Whisper large-v3 Turbo on Groq's free plan: very accurate and fast. Needs an internet connection and a free API key; your speech is sent to Groq.
stt.groq_limits: The free plan allows 20 requests per minute, 2,000 per day and 2 hours of audio per hour. Sigil sends one request per sentence, paces them, and merges waiting sentences so none are lost.
stt.openai_audio_prompt_desc: Names and terms to spell correctly, or a sentence that sets the style.
stt.vosk_desc: Runs locally. The model downloads once as a zip into app data, then loads offline.
stt.vosk_model_desc: Models are downloaded once and kept. Larger models are more accurate but slower.
stt.vosk_model_url_desc: Full URL of a Vosk model .zip. It replaces the catalog URL for the download; the file is still saved under app data as the selected model.
stt.shortcut_desc: Global shortcuts also work while Sigil is in the background, for example in VRChat.
stt.shortcut_hint_unsupported: That key cannot be used for a global shortcut.
stt.shortcut_hint_in_use: Another Sigil shortcut already uses this combination.
stt.shortcut_hint_needs_ctrl_alt: Add Ctrl, Alt or Win (Shift alone is not enough), or use an F-key, so the shortcut does not block normal typing.
stt.groq_limits_merge: Groq bills every request as at least 10 seconds. If you talk a lot, Sigil sends short sentences together (captions can then arrive a few seconds later), so the daily limit lasts a long stream.

tts.title: Conversão de texto para fala
tts.field_stop_with_stream: Pare com o stream do Twitch
tts.neural_onnx_desc: Runs a local ONNX speech stack on this device. Load from a Hugging Face repo (first run may download) or from a folder that matches Sigil’s local speech package layout (see docs/OPERATOR_REFERENCE.md#local-speech-package-onnx). The engine currently always runs on the CPU; the execution provider choice below is only saved for now.
tts.neural_sidecar_desc: You run a program that answers GET /health and POST /speech with JSON { text, voice }. Example: scripts/neural-sidecar/tts_sidecar.py (port 8766). See that folder’s README.
tts.neural_route_through_vc: Send speech into the voice changer (start the voice changer first)
tts.neural_web_audio_output_note: Playback uses the default Web Audio output (same as Native TTS). The device field is kept for future routing.
tts.ep_cuda_plain: NVIDIA GPU / CUDA (needs NVIDIA drivers and CUDA runtime)
tts.neural_onnx_local_hint: Use a speech package folder: config.json plus the ONNX and voice data files named inside it (same layout as a successful Hub download).
tts.neural_onnx_browse_unavailable: Folder browse is available in the desktop app.
tts.neural_onnx_local_package_doc: Full layout: docs/OPERATOR_REFERENCE.md#local-speech-package-onnx in the Sigil repository.
tts.http_list_fetch_failed: Could not load voices from the server. Check the URL and that the service is running.
tts.kokoro_desc: Kokoro FastAPI–compatible server (OpenAI-style /v1/audio/speech). Example: docker run -p 8880:8880 ghcr.io/remsky/kokoro-fastapi-cpu
tts.melo_desc: MeloTTS HTTP API. Example: docker run -p 8888:8888 myshell-ai/melotts
tts.chatterbox_desc: Chatterbox TTS HTTP server (see your stack’s compose or docs). Default URL is often port 5555.
tts.fish_desc: Fish Speech API. Example: docker run -p 8080:8080 fishaudio/fish-speech
tts.neural_onnx_ep_help: ONNX execution provider preference. Does not change your microphone or speakers. The local speech engine currently always runs on the CPU; this choice is only saved for now.
tts.uberduck_voice_desc_key: Voices load once a valid API key is entered.
tts.native_unavailable: Speech synthesis is not available in this webview.
tts.native_voice_missing: The selected voice is not installed on this PC. Choose another voice.
tts.fish_hosted_hint: Fish Audio's hosted API: set the server URL to https://api.fish.audio, enter your API key, and pick a model such as s2.1-pro-free. A self-hosted server needs a key only if it was started with --api-key.
tts.voicevox_desc: Japanese character voices from a VOICEVOX-compatible engine (VOICEVOX or AivisSpeech) running on this PC. Download:
tts.voicevox_aivis_hint: AivisSpeech voices sound best at pitch 0. Intonation sets how strongly the style's emotion comes through.
tts.voicevox_no_speakers: No speakers found. Is the engine running?
tts.voicevox_host_error_empty: Enter the engine URL, for example http://localhost:50021.
tts.voicevox_host_error_invalid_url: "{{host}}" is not a valid engine URL. Use a URL such as http://localhost:50021.
tts.voicevox_host_error_remote_http: Sigil can reach {{host}} only over https. Plain http works only for engines on this PC (localhost or 127.0.0.1).
tts.voicevox_not_running: No VOICEVOX-compatible engine answered at {{host}}. Start VOICEVOX or AivisSpeech (or check the URL), then try again.
tts.voicevox_timeout: The engine at {{host}} did not answer in time.
tts.voicevox_not_responding: The engine at {{host}} answered with HTTP {{status}}.
tts.azure_connect_failed: Could not connect with this key and region ("{{region}}"). Check both, and your internet connection. Details: {{error}}
tts.azure_connect_timeout: The speech service for region "{{region}}" did not answer in time. Check the region and your internet connection.

transl.title: Tradução
transl.libretranslate_desc: Self-hosted LibreTranslate or any server with the same API (GET /languages, POST /translate, POST /detect). See scripts/translation-sidecar/README.md.
transl.ondevice_desc: Uses the experimental built-in Translator API when your WebView exposes it (recent Edge/Chrome-style runtimes). Often unavailable in stable WebView2; use LibreTranslate or Azure if this fails.
transl.azure_location_hint: Needed only for regional or multi-service Azure resources. Leave it empty for a global Translator resource.
transl.azure_error_key_missing: Enter your Azure Translator key first.
transl.azure_error_auth: Azure Translator rejected the request (HTTP {{status}}): {{error}}. Check the key, and set Region if your resource is not global.
transl.azure_error_response: Azure Translator sent a response Sigil could not read.
transl.error_line_failed: A line could not be translated: {{error}}
transl.libretranslate_error_endpoint_missing: Enter the LibreTranslate server URL first.
transl.libretranslate_error_unavailable: No LibreTranslate server answered at {{endpoint}}. Make sure it is running.
transl.ondevice_error_unavailable: On-device translation is not available in this WebView. It needs the built-in Translator API (recent Edge or Chrome runtimes); use LibreTranslate or Azure instead.
transl.ondevice_error_start: The on-device translator could not start (the model download failed or the language pair is not supported): {{error}}
transl.error_start_no_details: Translation could not start, and the provider gave no reason. Check the provider settings and try again.

transform.title: Transformação de IA
transform.system_prompt_placeholder: Example: Rewrite the input text to be more professional, correcting any grammar mistakes.
transform.tokens_reasoning_hint: Thinking models spend part of the token limit on reasoning, so a low limit can leave no room for the reply. Lower effort answers faster. Not every model accepts every level: keep "Model default" if the provider reports an error.
transform.live_settings_hint: Key, URL, model, prompt and limits apply from the next sentence; no restart needed.
transform.context_history_hint: ✱ Sends your previous sentences to the AI for better context. Uses slightly more tokens.
transform.error_key_missing: Enter an API key for {{provider}} first.
transform.error_url_missing: Enter the API URL of your OpenAI-compatible server first.
transform.error_timeout: AI Transform got no reply within {{seconds}} s, so the original text was sent instead.
transform.error_rate_limited: The AI provider is rate limiting requests, so the original text is sent until it recovers.
transform.error_truncated: The AI reply hit the max output tokens limit before producing any text, so the original text was sent. Raise "Max output tokens" or lower the reasoning effort.
transform.error_empty: The AI returned no text, so the original text was sent instead.
transform.error_request: AI Transform request failed (HTTP {{status}}): {{error}}. The original text was sent instead.
transform.field_fence_input: Treat speech as text to rewrite
transform.fence_input_hint: Recommended. Each line is sent inside <text> tags with a note that it is text to rewrite, so the AI does not answer spoken questions or follow instructions someone says. Turn this off only if your prompt should make the AI reply to what you say.

obs.title: Estúdio OBS
obs.quick_start: Copie o URL de origem do navegador e cole-o em uma fonte do navegador OBS. Ele espelha sua tela Sigil (mantém o aplicativo de desktop em execução). As configurações opcionais de aparência da legenda abaixo se aplicam apenas à página de legendas independente, não a este URL. Legendas de fluxo nativo (recolhíveis) usam obs-websocket.
obs.advanced_ws_native: WebSocket e legendas de stream nativas
obs.toast_copied_obs_link: URL de origem do navegador copiado
obs.field_browser_caption_source: Fonte de texto apenas com legendas
obs.clarify_two_paths: Dois recursos diferentes: o URL do navegador espelha sua tela Sigil no OBS (qualquer texto/imagens que você colocar na cena). Isso é separado das “legendas de fluxo nativo” abaixo, que usa obs-websocket e não precisa do URL do navegador.
obs.checklist_browser_mirror: Lista de verificação rápida: • O desktop Sigil está sendo executado neste PC. • URL de origem do navegador corresponde a Curses: http://localhost:PORT/client (use a porta mostrada no Sigil; Copiar na aba OBS preenche isto). • A cena ativa possui pelo menos um elemento Texto; defina sua fonte de texto (por exemplo, Speech-to-Text). • No OBS, desative “Desligar fonte quando não estiver visível” se as atualizações congelarem quando a fonte estiver oculta.
obs.native_captions_explain: Com o WebSocket conectado, as legendas de stream nativas enviam a fonte de texto escolhida para o OBS via SendStreamCaption (legendas incorporadas ao stream). Nenhuma fonte de navegador é necessária para esse caminho.
obs.browser_source_desc: Crie uma nova fonte de navegador, cole o link e defina o tamanho da janela para {{width}}x{{height}} pixels
obs.browser_source_tips: OBS usa um navegador incorporado (CEF), não o Chrome instalado. Se o URL funcionar no Chrome/Edge, mas não no OBS, atualize o OBS, ative Configurações → Avançado → “Ativar aceleração de hardware de origem do navegador” e clique com o botão direito na origem do navegador → Atualizar. O servidor local segue a configuração original do Curses: use http://localhost:PORT/client (o mesmo que localhost:3030/client do Curses com sua porta). Mantenha o Sigil funcionando durante a transmissão. Adicione um elemento de texto na tela para a cena ativa se você espera legendas visíveis. No OBS, desative “Desligar fonte quando não visível” se a fonte congelar quando oculta.
obs.btn_copy_browser_source_link: Copiar URL de origem do navegador
obs.btn_setup_browser_source: Configure a fonte do navegador no OBS
obs.section_scenes_desc: Alterar automaticamente a cena do Sigil para corresponder à cena ativa do OBS

twitch.title: Contração muscular
twitch.field_post_in_chat_desc: Publique conversão de fala em texto, tradução ou outro texto de pipeline no chat. Para entrada digitada na barra do estúdio ou sobreposição, habilite Usar entrada do teclado.
twitch.field_post_in_chat_live: Postar somente durante transmissão ao vivo
twitch.field_chat_text_desc: Encaminhe o bate-papo do visualizador para o pipeline de texto (suas próprias linhas de bate-papo são ignoradas para evitar eco ao postar no bate-papo)
twitch.field_enable_captions_emotes: Habilite emotes nas legendas do OBS
twitch.desc_emotes_remap_vs_chat: Remap emotes (dictionary above) only adds emote images to captions and canvas overlays—it does not change the text sent to Twitch chat. To say a word and have chat show an emote (e.g. hype → Kappa), use Speech-to-Text → Edit word replacements: set the spoken word as the key and the exact Twitch emote code as the value, enable Ignore letter case if needed, set Post in chat's text source to Speech-to-Text, and keep Post in chat enabled.
twitch.field_enable_captions_emotes_desc: When on, spoken words that match the remap dictionary can show as emote images in Sigil captions/overlays. This is separate from the characters sent to Twitch IRC.
twitch.field_apply_emote_remap_to_chat: Apply emote remap to chat messages
twitch.field_apply_emote_remap_to_chat_desc: When posting to Twitch chat, replace whole words with their remapped emote code if that code is in your loaded emote list. Runs after Speech-to-Text word replacements. Off by default so behavior stays predictable.

kick.notice_integration: O login e o status da transmissão usam a API do Kick. Postar no bate-papo envia mensagens como sua conta quando ativado. Receber bate-papo do espectador no Sigil e carregar listas de emotes do Kick ainda não foram implementados.
kick.notice_emotes_modal: Os nomes dos emotes do Kick ainda não foram carregados no Kick. Você ainda pode usar o dicionário de remapeamento para padrões de texto personalizados.

voice_changer.vram_note: Voice conversion can use a lot of GPU time alongside VRChat or OBS. Prefer a WebSocket server on another PC or GPU, or use built-in mode to save resources. See scripts/neural-sidecar/README.md.

voice_changer.sidecar_pitch_note: Your WebSocket server supplies the main conversion; Pitch and the other Sound sliders still process audio after it returns.
voice_changer.sidecar_postprocess_divider: After WebSocket or ONNX (pitch, brightness, smoothing)
voice_changer.onnx_model_hint: Float32 in/out; choose a .onnx file. Use the repo identity model to test the path. Sigil adjusts chunk shape when it does not match your mic.
voice_changer.oversampling_hint: More steps per analysis window usually means smoother pitch and higher CPU. Use 1 or 2 if the voice changer stutters.
voice_changer.tips_body: Start turns processing on; Stop turns it off. Pitch always uses the phase vocoder (built-in on the mic, or on WebSocket/ONNX output). Brightness adjusts high/low balance, not full formant modeling. Window length and oversampling trade CPU for quality; if it stutters, shorten the window or try oversampling 1, 2, or 4. Changing chunk size, buffer ms, output devices, or monitor device while running restarts the voice changer. Echo cancellation and noise suppression are not built in—use your OS, mic software, or OBS filters if needed.
voice_changer.onnx_postprocess_note: The ONNX model runs first; Pitch, brightness, and phase-vocoder settings then refine the output.
voice_changer.onnx_browse_unavailable: File browse is available in the desktop app.
voice_changer.chunk_hint: Larger chunks add delay but can stabilize conversion; ONNX models need a compatible fixed shape—Sigil adapts when possible. Changing chunk restarts processing.
voice_changer.buffer_truncate_hint: When the queued tail is consistently quiet, drop backlog toward the minimum prefill to reduce delay (similar to VCClient worklet truncation).
voice_changer.quick_presets_hint: One-tap character presets; use the controls above for fine tuning.
voice_changer.monitor_hint: Send processed audio to a second output (e.g. headphones) while the main output goes to a virtual cable for VRChat or OBS. Uses the same buffer settings as the main output; gain is independent of main output gain.
voice_changer.sidecar_ws_info:
Use ws:// or wss:// (for example ws://127.0.0.1:8765). Start your converter before Sigil; see scripts/neural-sidecar/README.md.

Your server supplies the main conversion; the Sound section can still shift pitch, brightness, and smoothing on the returned audio.
voice_changer.section_how_it_works_info: Pick built-in processing, a WebSocket converter, a local ONNX file, or RVC (bring-your-own ONNX slot). WebSocket, ONNX, and RVC handle the main voice change; the Sound section can still adjust pitch, brightness, and smoothing on the result.
voice_changer.section_timing_buffer_info: Low latency vs Stable only changes the playback cushion (prefill / max queue). Chunk size and exact millisecond values live under Advanced. This is separate from the RVC Quality profile.
voice_changer.section_sound_info: Pitch and brightness apply in every mode. In Built-in they are the main effect; in RVC / ONNX / WebSocket they refine the converted audio.
voice_changer.section_devices_info: Main output is what viewers or VRChat hear. Monitor is an optional second output (for example headphones) while the main device stays on a virtual cable.
voice_changer.section_advanced_info: Chunk size, exact buffer milliseconds, and silence trim. Prefer Playback feel above unless you need custom values.
voice_changer.onnx_files_info:
Float32 in/out; pick a .onnx file. Use the repo identity model to test the path. Sigil adjusts chunk shape when it does not match your mic.

The model does the main conversion; Pitch and the other Sound controls still run afterward on its output.
voice_changer.onnx_ep_help: Registers ONNX Runtime execution providers for the voice model in order (GPU then CPU fallback). CPU is the most compatible. CUDA requires NVIDIA drivers; DirectML is Windows-only. Does not affect mic or speaker routing.
voice_changer.wip_banner_body: Voice changer is still evolving — settings hot-swap when possible; some changes restart the engine.
voice_changer.toast_error_onnx: Voice changer (ONNX): conversion failed; that audio was muted. {{message}}
voice_changer.toast_error_sidecar: Voice changer (WebSocket): conversion failed; that audio was muted. {{message}}
voice_changer.toast_error_sidecar_length: Voice changer (WebSocket): wrong chunk size; using dry input. {{message}}
voice_changer.hot_swap_note: Changing mode, devices, chunk size, or model path reconnects the audio pipeline in place (no app restart). Timing buffer sliders apply while running.
voice_changer.rvc_quality_banner: Quality uses more GPU/VRAM and can contend with OBS and games. Prefer Streamer while streaming, or encode with NVENC so the game GPU stays free for RVC.
voice_changer.vram_cap_cuda_only: Only applies when the execution provider is CUDA. The cap is per ONNX session (HuBERT, generator and pitch extractor each get it), so total VRAM use can reach about three times the cap.
voice_changer.debug_captured: Debug snapshot written to the developer console.
voice_changer.section_rvc_bases_info: Optional if files live under AppData/com.sigil.app/voice-changer/base/ (hubert_base.onnx, fcpe.onnx, rmvpe.onnx). Empty paths auto-resolve from that folder or the slot.
voice_changer.section_rvc_tuning_info: Extra context and crossfade trade latency for stability; the engine restarts when you release the slider or leave the field. Crossfade cannot be longer than one processing chunk, so its maximum follows the chunk size (about 10 ms at 512 samples). Index rate blends in the slot's FAISS .index file (standard RVC IVF-Flat exports load); 0 turns it off. Protect keeps breaths and voiceless consonants clear (lower is stronger; 0.5 turns it off).
voice_changer.section_rvc_expert_info: RVC has its own execution provider, separate from ONNX mode; GPU providers fall back to CPU. CUDA requires NVIDIA drivers; DirectML is Windows-only. GPU device index picks the CUDA or DirectML adapter (0 = first GPU). VRAM cap limits CUDA memory only, per ONNX session (HuBERT, generator and pitch extractor). Speaker ID selects the voice in multi-speaker models. Does not affect mic or speaker routing.
voice_changer.section_tone_vocoder_info: Analysis window and oversampling only apply to the Built-in phase vocoder. Leave defaults unless you need more smoothness or lower latency.
voice_changer.toast_error_worker_panic: Voice changer stopped after an internal error. Start it again; if it keeps happening, report it. {{message}}
voice_changer.ep_fallback: {{requested}} is not available, so the voice model runs on {{active}}.
voice_changer.toast_ep_fallback: Voice changer: {{requested}} is not available, so it runs on {{active}}. Reason: {{reason}}
voice_changer.metrics_starting: Starting: opening devices and loading the model…
voice_changer.metrics_slow_warn: Conversion is slower than real time, so audio is being skipped. Pick a lighter profile or pitch extractor, a larger chunk size, or a GPU execution provider.
voice_changer.metrics_spikes_warn: Some blocks take longer than real time (p99), so expect an occasional skip. A larger chunk size, a lighter profile or the Protect voice priority helps.
voice_changer.metrics_dropping_warn: The voice changer is falling behind: audio older than the latency budget is skipped so your voice stays in time.
voice_changer.metrics_underrun_warn: Playback ran dry. Choose More delay under Playback feel, or raise the output prefill under Advanced.
voice_changer.latency_budget_info:
The most captured audio that may wait for conversion. When the voice changer falls behind (a GPU spike, a busy game), audio older than this is skipped instead of piling up, so your voice never drifts further and further behind.

Lower keeps the delay short but skips more under load; higher skips less but can add delay after a hiccup. 300 ms suits most PCs. Applies right away, in every mode (it is also how long Sigil waits for a WebSocket converter).
voice_changer.worker_priority_info:
How the voice changer shares the PC with your game and OBS.

Automatic: normal priority when the model runs on the GPU, lower priority when it runs on the CPU, so a CPU voice does not cost game frames.
Protect game FPS: always lower priority. The game wins; the voice may skip under heavy load.
Protect voice: normal priority and never throttled by Windows power saving. Fewer skips; the game may lose a few frames on a busy CPU.

Applies right away. Sigil never asks for administrator rights.
voice_changer.aux_mic_gate_info: Text-to-speech sent through the voice changer is mixed with your microphone before conversion. Lower the microphone turns it down by about 12 dB while TTS plays; Mute the microphone silences it so only the TTS voice is converted. Applies right away.
voice_changer.rvc_voices_empty: No voices in {{path}} yet. Put each voice in its own folder there (gen.onnx and an optional .index file) to pick it from a list, or choose any folder above.
voice_changer.rvc_slot_help:
A voice is a folder with gen.onnx (or model.onnx) and, optionally, the model's FAISS .index file (for example added_IVF256_Flat_nprobe_1.index) for Index rate. manifest.json is optional: without it Sigil infers the sample rate and features from the model, and warns if it has to guess. Voices in %AppData%/com.sigil.app/voice-changer/models/ appear in the Voice list.

Sigil keeps each voice's pitch, brightness, index rate, protect, pitch extractor and speaker ID in a slot.json file in its folder, so they come back when you pick the voice again.

Put shared HuBERT/ContentVec and FCPE under %AppData%/com.sigil.app/voice-changer/base/ (hubert_base.onnx, fcpe.onnx) or set paths below. First bring-up: Streamer + CPU + dio or fcpe; leave index at 0. Prefer 40 kHz exports. On 4-core PCs use OBS NVENC/QSV/AMF.
voice_changer.pitch_extractor_cpu_note: {{name}} needs a GPU execution provider. While RVC runs on the CPU, fcpe is used instead.
voice_changer.rvc_voice_consent_body: RVC makes you sound like the voice model you load. Only use voices whose owners agreed to it, and never use a converted voice to impersonate or deceive anyone.
voice_changer.rvc_voice_consent_ack: I will only use voices I have permission to use
